FACT: Ned is turning 25, based in Vilnius, solo founder building Whisnap (voice transcription, Rust+Tauri+React). Shipped 536k lines in 5 months (14x industry average). High-amplitude spike/crash pattern is feature not bug. Needs physical suffering (half-Ironman training) + external pressure to feel alive - pure building alone feels hollow.
CONTEXT: This is who he fundamentally is as an operator and person. Summer 2025 was peak state (training + building + weed = 'electric').
AFFECTS: Don't treat crashes as problems to solve. Understand the physical component is non-negotiable for his mental state.
